title: Pluh
blurb: Conversation over, thought complete, nothing further to add. This tiny absurdist syllable — attributed to a cat, as most of the best ones are — became a whole communication style in the brainrot era, functioning as a full stop, a shrug and an exit all at once. Its uselessness is the point: it commits to nothing, means nothing, and cannot be argued with, which makes it the perfect reply to a message you have read and do not intend to engage with. Send it as agreement, dismissal, or farewell. Pluh.
origin: The viral 'pluh' cat clip — the internet's conversation-ending syllable.
